subject.title: perf: measure and reduce the shared route entry bundle

question: Should ClawHub schedule the proposed single-route bundle experiment now, or defer it under the broader web-performance plan?
rationale: The issue intentionally makes further refactoring conditional on measured preload reduction and waterfall results, so maintainers must sponsor the experiment and define whether its outcome warrants follow-up work.

options.title: Sponsor the measured A/B
options.body: Approve the single-route extraction and require baseline/candidate manifest measurements plus cold-browser navigation evidence before expanding scope.

options.title: Defer under the umbrella
options.body: Keep the investigation documented but schedule it later through https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/issues/2925 after higher-priority performance work.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the measured A/B
recommendation.body: Approve the single-route extraction and require baseline/candidate manifest measurements plus cold-browser navigation evidence before expanding scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They own the existing measurements, broader proposal, and adjacent loader work needed to frame and execute the stop/go experiment.
